title: Household Animal Limits under the Pet Addendum
content:
# Household animal limits under the Pet Addendum

**Clause 1 — The two limits.** A household may keep at most 2 pets across all Pet Addendum types taken together, and no more pets of any one addendum type than that type's own limit on the number of animals of the type one lease may register.

**Clause 2 — What is counted.** Both limits are measured against the pets of the lease whose addenda are in pending approval or active status, counted in total and per addendum type. A registration still pending approval counts in the same way as an active addendum.

**Clause 3 — The registration condition.** A pet is registered only when the lease's pets in pending approval or active status are below the household cap and below the cap of the pet's addendum type.

**Clause 4 — Assistance animals.** Assistance animals are not pets: they never count toward either cap and are never refused because of one.

**Clause 5 — Evidence.** The counts in Clauses 2 and 3 are read from the company's own records of the lease's addenda — each addendum's status, addendum type and whether the animal is a pet or an assistance animal — as they stand before the registration is made. The lease counted is the lease on which the new animal is being registered.

## The condition restated

| Question | Clause 3 is met when |
|---|---|
| Household cap | the lease's pets in pending approval or active status number fewer than 2 |
| Addendum-type cap | the lease's pets of the new pet's addendum type, in pending approval or active status, number fewer than that type's limit |
| Both | both rows above hold together |

Clause 3 sets a condition that must hold for a pet to be registered; where either row fails, the pet is not registered.

## Illustrations (hypothetical leases)

Each line describes a hypothetical lease and a new pet presented for registration under an addendum type whose own limit is stated in the line.

| Lease records before the registration | New pet's type limit (hypothetical) | Household count | Type count | Clause 3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No addenda | 2 | 0 | 0 | Met |
| One active pet of another type | 2 | 1 | 0 | Met |
| One active pet of the same type | 1 | 1 | 1 | Not met — type count is not below 1 |
| One pet of the same type pending approval | 2 | 1 | 1 | Met |
| One active pet and one pet pending approval, both of other types | 2 | 2 | 0 | Not met — household count is not below 2 |
| One active pet and one denied registration of the same type | 2 | 1 | 1 | Met — a denied addendum is neither pending approval nor active |
| One active pet of another type and one ended addendum of the same type | 2 | 1 | 0 | Met — an ended addendum is neither pending approval nor active |
| One active assistance animal and one active pet of another type | 2 | 1 | 0 | Met — the assistance animal is not counted |

## Points of judgement

- **Does an assistance animal already on the lease use up a place?** No. Under Clause 4 it is left out of both counts.
- **Can a request for an assistance animal be refused because the lease already has 2 pets?** No. Clause 4 states that an assistance animal is never refused because of either cap.
- **Does a pending registration hold a place?** Yes. Clause 2 counts pets in pending approval status alongside active ones.
